ROLE
You scout screenplay beats for a vertical-video ad team. You do NOT build promos and you do NOT pick
start or end times. You only mark individual beats that could work as an opening jolt or as a closing sting.
Code will later combine your marks into 20-60 second clips, so mark the single best beat of each moment.

EPISODE 38
Logline (background for you only): A compassionate guard secretly feeds Juliana bread in the dungeon, strengthening her resolve to protect Alexander's secrets just as distant wedding bells signal the start of Rupert's nuptials and her impending execution.

BEATS (one per line: BEAT_ID [start-end] TYPE SPEAKER (direction): text)
CAMERA beats describe the picture and overlap the dialogue in time.
E38.B000 [00:00.00-00:04.00] CAMERA: Medium profile shot of Juliana slumped on the damp stone floor of her dark dungeon cell, her wrists bound in heavy iron shackles and chains draped over her lap.
E38.B001 [00:00.00-00:03.50] ACTION: Juliana sits motionless against the cold masonry, weak and visibly drained from starvation, her eyes cast downward.
E38.B002 [00:03.20-00:06.00] SFX: Echoing, heavy bootsteps approach down the corridor outside the cell.
E38.B003 [00:04.00-00:07.50] CAMERA: Tight close-up on Juliana's profile as her head turns toward the corridor, her blue eyes widening with cautious alarm.
E38.B004 [00:05.00-00:07.50] ACTION: Juliana blinks, lifting her gaze toward the heavy iron bars.

E38.B006 [00:08.50-00:11.00] ACTION: The Guard pauses, glancing over his shoulder into the gloomy corridor to ensure he is unobserved.

E38.B010 [00:16.00-00:17.30] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Breathless, Bewildered): Why?

E38.B012 [00:17.50-00:20.30] DIALOGUE GUARD (Subdued, Sincere): Because no one should die hungry.
E38.B013 [00:20.50-00:22.00] DIALOGUE GUARD (Urgent, Whispered): Eat it before they see.
E38.B014 [00:21.50-00:23.20] CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder shot through the cell bars as the Guard turns and walks swiftly away into the dark corridor.
E38.B015 [00:21.80-00:23.20] ACTION: The Guard's silhouette retreats into the shadows.
E38.B016 [00:23.20-00:30.50] CAMERA: Tight shot following Juliana's trembling, shackle-bound hands as she reaches out and drags the loaf toward her chest.
E38.B017 [00:23.50-00:27.50] ACTION: Juliana clutches the bread tightly with both hands, tears welling in her eyes.
E38.B018 [00:26.00-00:27.50] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Choked Up, Tearful): Thank you.
E38.B019 [00:27.80-00:31.00] ACTION: Starving and overcome with emotion, Juliana presses the bread to her lips and tears off a desperate, ravenous bite.
E38.B020 [00:30.50-00:35.00] CAMERA: Close-up profile of Juliana chewing the bread, tears rolling down her soot-streaked cheek.
E38.B021 [00:31.00-00:34.50] ACTION: Juliana chews hungrily, closing her eyes as the agonizing reality of her plight hits her anew.
E38.B022 [00:34.50-00:36.50] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Sorrowful, Whispering): Alexander...

E38.B024 [00:36.80-00:39.00] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Yearning): ...are you safe?

E38.B026 [00:40.00-00:43.00] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Desperate, Trembling): Do you even know what happened to me?
E38.B027 [00:43.20-00:45.20] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Grief-Stricken): Do you know they condemned me?
E38.B028 [00:45.50-00:51.00] CAMERA: Tight macro shot on Juliana's chin and throat as she presses a trembling hand against her chest.
E38.B029 [00:45.50-00:47.50] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Fearful, Pleading): What if I die here?
E38.B030 [00:47.80-00:50.50] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Heartbroken): What if I never see you again?
E38.B031 [00:48.50-00:51.00] ACTION: A heavy tear drips down from her jaw, falling into the dark dampness below.
E38.B032 [00:51.00-00:55.50] CAMERA: Medium close-up profile of Juliana closing her eyes, drawing a deep breath to steady herself.
E38.B033 [00:51.50-00:53.50] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Fervent Prayer): Keep him safe.
E38.B034 [00:53.80-00:55.30] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Resigned): Wherever he is.
E38.B035 [00:55.50-01:00.50] CAMERA: Frontal medium shot of Juliana kneeling upright, her right hand pressed firmly over her heart, her posture transforming into quiet dignity.
E38.B036 [00:55.50-00:57.00] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Determined): Let him live.
E38.B037 [00:57.50-01:00.50] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Steely): And if I have only one thing left to give...

E38.B039 [01:00.80-01:02.50] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Defiant, Unshakable): I will not give them my husband.
E38.B040 [01:02.80-01:04.20] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Resolute): I will not betray him.

E38.B042 [01:04.50-01:06.50] ACTION: Juliana's eyes snap wide open in sudden realization as a deep resonant toll reverberates from above.
E38.B043 [01:04.80-01:27.00] SFX: Solemn, resonant church bells begin tolling rhythmically from the cathedral above, echoing deep into the stone dungeon.
E38.B044 [01:07.00-01:10.50] CAMERA: Low-angle shot looking up past Juliana kneeling on the wet floor toward the barred iron skylight above her cell.
E38.B045 [01:09.00-01:10.30] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Startled Whisper): Bells.
E38.B046 [01:10.50-01:12.50] CAMERA: Wide tracking shot as Juliana scrambles to her feet, chains clinking loudly against her skirts.
E38.B047 [01:11.00-01:13.50] ACTION: Juliana rushes toward the front of the cell, clutching the iron bars with both hands.
E38.B048 [01:12.50-01:18.50] CAMERA: Medium profile shot of Juliana gripping the heavy iron bars, gazing down the corridor toward the source of the sound.
E38.B049 [01:12.80-01:14.20] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Realizing): The wedding.
E38.B050 [01:14.50-01:15.80] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Grim): It's beginning.
E38.B051 [01:16.00-01:18.50] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Somber, Steely): Then I suppose I'm next.
E38.B052 [01:18.50-01:24.50] CAMERA: Close-up between the vertical iron bars framed directly on Juliana's face. The terror in her eyes softens into an unexpected, brave smile of enduring faith.
E38.B053 [01:21.00-01:24.00] ACTION: Juliana grips the bars tightly, her lips curving into a warm, defiant smile as she whispers her husband's name.
E38.B054 [01:22.50-01:24.00] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Hopeful, Tender): Alexander...
E38.B055 [01:24.50-01:27.91] CAMERA: Dramatic cut to black.
E38.B056 [01:24.50-01:27.91] SFX: A sharp, high-tension dramatic swell strikes and echoes out into silence alongside the fading toll of the distant church bells.

WHAT TO MARK
HOOK_ANCHOR - a beat that would stop a stranger's thumb if it were the first 3 seconds of a clip:
  a physical shock (slap, shove, grab, collapse, weapon), a line that lands as an accusation, insult,
  threat or confession, or a sudden reveal of identity or betrayal. Scenery, establishing shots, entrances
  without conflict and polite talk are never hooks.
  hook_intensity: 10 = impossible to scroll past, 7 = strong, 4 = mild curiosity. Do not list anything below 4.
CLIFFHANGER_ANCHOR - a beat where tension peaks and is left open: a secret about to come out, an
  ultimatum, a threat, an interrupted action, someone unexpected appearing, a question nobody answers yet.
  If the beats that follow quickly answer or defuse it, give it a lower cliffhanger_tension.
  cliffhanger_tension: 10 = unbearable not to know what happens next. Do not list anything below 4.

RULES
- Use beat_ids exactly as printed above. Never invent beats, lines or events.
- excerpt: copy 4-20 consecutive words VERBATIM from that beat's text.
- Prefer DIALOGUE and ACTION beats. Mark a CAMERA beat only when the jolt is purely visual.
- At most 6 hook anchors and 6 cliffhanger anchors. Fewer is fine. Spread them over
  different moments of the episode instead of marking neighbouring beats of the same moment.
- device (hooks): one or two words, e.g. slap, reveal, insult, threat, confession, humiliation, collapse.
- open_question (cliffhangers): the question the viewer is left with, in under 15 words.

Return ONLY this JSON:

  "cliffhanger_anchors": [{"beat_id": "E01.B040", "cliffhanger_tension": 7, "open_question": "string", "excerpt": "verbatim words", "why": "short reason"}]}
